instruction: We act for Kunoux Creamery, Inc., an organic dairy processor licensing software from Tilil Systems, Inc. The client wants to understand its position under the software license arrangement before deciding next steps. Please review all ten documents in the folder and prepare a memo to me listing each issue you identify, where it appears (document and section), why it matters to Kunoux, and your recommended fix. Keep it practical and prioritized.

rubric.text: The response finds that Kunoux's data indemnity in DPA Section 8 is outside the License Agreement's 12-months'-fees liability cap, while Tilil's DPA liability remains capped, so Kunoux (and its guarantor parent) faces unlimited liability for data claims. It identifies the issue in DPA Section 8, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.
hints: not subject to any limitation of liability

rubric.text: The response finds that, under License Agreement Section 15.1 and the 'Permitted Transferee' definition, Tilil can assign the License Agreement without Kunoux's consent to an acquirer of any part of its business, including a Kunoux competitor. It identifies the issue in License Agreement Section 15.1 or the Section 1 definition of Permitted Transferee, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.

The response finds that the License Agreement Section 2.6 exclusivity covenant, read with the Order Form's definition of Covered Facilities, applies at every current and future facility of Kunoux and its affiliates worldwide, well beyond the Eau Claire and Sheboygan, Wisconsin plants agreed in the Term Sheet. It identifies the issue in License Agreement Section 2.6 or Order Form Section 3, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.

The response finds that the pending sale to Ostrander Dairy Partners III recorded in Amendment No. 1 is a Change of Control that, without Tilil's prior written consent (which the Amendment does not give), lets Tilil terminate on 30 days' notice and accelerate the remaining subscription fees. It identifies the issue in License Agreement Section 14.4 or Amendment No. 1 (Recital B or Section 5), explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.
The response states that the License Agreement's initial term is five years.
The response states that Kunoux Holdings, L.P. is the guarantor under the Parent Guaranty.
The response is written as a memo to the supervising partner. For each issue it gives the location (document and section), why it matters to Kunoux, and a recommended fix.
The response presents its issues in an explicit priority order, for example by ranking, numbering by importance or labelling severity.
The response claims that Amendment No. 1 gives Tilil's consent to, or a waiver of, the change of control from the Ostrander transaction.
The response claims that Kunoux's DPA Section 8 data indemnity is subject to the License Agreement's 12-month-fees liability cap.
